Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use this route to publish the annual CVD report and its one-page public health
update from approved CVD event and mortality releases.

## Before you start

- Confirm the report year, source data releases and next report version.
- Complete and review the year-specific interpretation and Special chapter files.
- Identify the authorised reviewer and approver.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Confirm the report inputs and wording → build and review → approve and publish →
render and deploy the website.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Confirm the report scope and authority** — report year; approved source releases; next version; year-specific content; authorised approver | Check [Before starting the annual report](../../operations/post-redcap/annual-report.qmd#before-starting). |
| 2 | [Public Methods]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--methods} | **Preserve the approved public meaning** — event and mortality definitions; counts; rates; interpretation; limitations | Check the relevant pages under [What BNR reports](../../methods/measures/index.qmd) and [Interpreting the measures](../../methods/interpretation/index.qmd) while reviewing the year-specific wording. |
| 3 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Build, review, approve and publish the complete report package** — annual PDF; one-page update; two landing pages; shared report record; unchanged approved files | Follow the complete [Technical annual-report procedure](../workflows/reporting/annual-report.qmd), using the [Operations annual-report route](../../operations/post-redcap/annual-report.qmd) for responsibilities and decisions. |
| 4 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Render and deploy the two report pages** — full report; public health update; automatic report listings; Git review; pull request; live-site check | Follow [Edit and publish website content](edit-publish-website-content.qmd). Quarto discovers both published landing pages during the normal render; no separate listing-refresh action is required. |

## How to confirm completion

Both PDFs and landing pages are published, the website deployment succeeds,
and the annual report and public health update appear correctly in the live
report listings.
